name: cautious_push
description: Commander-selected Marine squad attacks the objective, locally retreats on low HP or superior visible enemy value, resumes after hysteresis/cooldown. No economy or global army control.

parameters.retreat_ratio: Enemy/own mineral+gas cost threshold; default 1.3, finite >1.
parameters.resume_ratio: Resume below this value ratio; default 0.8, below retreat_ratio.
parameters.health_floor: Retreat below average HP fraction, default 0.35, range 0..1.
